name: Zürich
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Zürich
summary: A square flag divided diagonally, white in the upper hoist and blue in the lower fly. Zürich joined the Swiss Confederacy in 1351.
origin: The diagonal white and blue banner is recorded from the 14th century. Like all Swiss cantonal flags it is a square banner of the canton's arms.
facts: Thurgau's flag is also divided diagonally, with two lions.
clues: A square flag split diagonally into white and blue.
The flag of Switzerland's largest city and its canton.
